headline: Biointra could be the next Mexican company listed on the Nasdaq
summary: Biointra's parent company has applied to list its shares on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The application was made without a public offering of securities.
why: A Nasdaq listing gives a company access to US capital markets and investor visibility. Listing applications from smaller companies are often watched for their funding and valuation implications.
original_headline: Biointra podría ser la próxima empresa mexicana listada en el Nasdaq
